comments.headline: Overhead line trees lack species, height, clearance details
comments.summary: Proposed trees near the overhead electric line lack species identification, mature height designation, and clearance dimensions from both the conductor and utility poles. This prevents verification of utility compatibility, code-required clearances, and Austin Energy approval requirements.

details.text: Proposed trees marked as 'M' (Mitigation Trees) on Landscape Plan are not identified by species. Cannot verify whether non-utility-compatible trees are proposed within 15 lateral feet of conductor.

runComments.comment: Proposed trees (labeled 'M' - Mitigation Trees) are shown near the overhead electric line on the Landscape Plan, but their species are not identified on this sheet. Cannot verify whether non-utility-compatible trees are proposed within 15 lateral feet of the conductor without species identification.

details.text: Proposed trees near overhead electric line are not differentiated by mature height or size on Landscape Plan. Cannot verify whether large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) are proposed within 25 lateral feet of the distribution conductor.

runComments.comment: Proposed trees near the overhead electric line are not differentiated by mature height or size on the Landscape Plan. Cannot verify whether large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) are proposed within 25 lateral feet of the distribution conductor.

details.text: Utility poles marked with 'x' symbols on Landscape Plan along the overhead electric line have no clearance dimensions to proposed tree locations. Cannot verify that all trees maintain required 10-foot lateral clearance from poles.

runComments.comment: Utility poles are shown on the Landscape Plan (marked with 'x' symbols along the OHE line), and proposed trees are depicted throughout the plan. However, no clearance dimensions or measurements are provided between pole locations and tree locations. Cannot verify that all trees maintain the required 10-foot lateral clearance from poles.

details.text: Proposed trees near overhead electric line are shown only with letter 'M' designation without species names on Landscape Plan Sheet 31. Plant schedule on Sheet 35 does not cross-reference locations relative to utilities, violating drawing convention.

runComments.comment: Proposed trees on the Landscape Plan that are located near the overhead electric line are identified only by the letter 'M' (Mitigation Tree) with no species names or common names provided on Sheet 31. The plant schedule on Sheet 35 lists proposed species but does not cross-reference their locations relative to utilities. Species identification is required on the Landscape Plan for trees near electric facilities to verify compliance with utility compatibility requirements.

details.text: All proposed trees on Landscape Plan shown with identical symbol regardless of mature height. Large trees (40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) are not visually or textually differentiated from smaller trees, preventing verification of overhead clearance compliance.

runComments.comment: Large trees proposed on the Landscape Plan are not differentiated from smaller trees by size, caliper, mature height, or any visual or textual designation. All mitigation and proposed trees are shown with the same symbol regardless of their mature height. Differentiation is required to allow reviewers to verify that large trees (40+ feet mature height per ECM Appendix F) comply with clearance restrictions from overhead electric facilities.

details.text: No tree clearance measurements or dimensions are shown on Landscape Plan between proposed trees and overhead electric line. Measurement methodology (pole centerline vs. conductor, trunk center vs. canopy edge) cannot be assessed due to absence of dimensions.

runComments.comment: No tree clearance measurements or dimensions are shown on the Landscape Plan between proposed trees and the overhead electric line. Therefore, the measurement methodology (whether measured from pole centerline vs. conductor, or from trunk center vs. canopy edge) cannot be assessed. This item is not verifiable due to absence of measurements rather than incorrect measurement methodology.

details.text: No tree clearance dimensions on Landscape Plan prevent evaluation of whether measurements reference tree trunk center or canopy edge. Item is not verifiable due to absence of measurements.

runComments.comment: No tree clearance measurements are dimensioned on the Landscape Plan, so the measurement reference point (tree trunk center vs. canopy edge) cannot be evaluated. This checklist item cannot be verified due to the absence of measurements rather than incorrect methodology.

details.text: Without species identification and clearance dimensions on Landscape Plan, cannot determine whether proposed trees are within prohibited clearance zones from overhead line. Austin Energy written approval for variations, if required, cannot be verified or documented.

runComments.comment: Without species identification for trees on the Landscape Plan and without clearance dimensions, it cannot be determined whether any proposed trees are within prohibited clearance zones. Therefore, the presence or absence of Austin Energy written approval for variations cannot be assessed. If trees are determined to be within restricted zones, such approval would be required and must be documented on the plans.

comments.headline: Underground equipment trees lack clearance and barrier details
comments.summary: Proposed trees near underground electrical equipment (transformers and pull boxes shown on Sheet 21) lack clearance dimensions on the Landscape Plan and have no root barrier specifications. Cannot verify required clearances and root protection in the 20-foot utility equipment zone.
comments.crossDep: Utility department (cross-sheet equipment coordination); Landscape architect (plan coordination)
comments.attn: Verify coordination between Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) showing equipment locations and Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) showing tree locations with required clearance dimensions.

details.text: Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) shows underground equipment (transformers and pull boxes), but relationship to proposed tree locations on Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) is not clearly depicted. No clearance dimensions provided between equipment and tree locations.

runComments.comment: Underground electric equipment (transformers and pull boxes) is shown on the Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21), but the relationship between these equipment locations and the proposed tree locations on the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) is not clear. No clearance dimensions are shown between underground equipment and proposed trees.

details.text: Landscape Plan does not indicate which trees are within 20-lateral-foot zone of underground equipment, nor does it show required root barrier specifications (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment).

runComments.comment: The Landscape Plan does not indicate which proposed trees are within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment, nor does it show root barrier specifications. Cannot verify required root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment) for trees within the 20-foot zone.
